# search_conversation_history_tool

> Search the message history of a conversation for a keyword or phrase.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `conversation` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (always on); grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=search_conversation_history_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Search the message history of a conversation for a keyword or phrase.
Searches ALL messages — including older ones that are no longer part of
the model's context window (compacted or omitted for length). Returns
matching snippets with message ids, senders, and timestamps, newest first.

Use this when the user refers to something said earlier in the
conversation that you cannot see in your current context.

Pass `message_id` instead of `query` to fetch ONE message in full. Recalled
memories are deliberately short and carry the id of the message they came
from — follow that pointer when the summary is not enough.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conversation_id` | integer | no | ID of the conversation to search (defaults to the current conversation) |
| `query` | string | no | Keyword or phrase to search for (case-insensitive substring match) |
| `message_id` | integer | no | Fetch this one message IN FULL instead of searching. Use the id a truncated memory or search snippet gave you. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum matches to return (default 10, max 20) |

## Example

```json
{"name": "search_conversation_history_tool", "arguments": {"conversation_id": 3870, "query": "budget", "limit": 10}}
```

Fetch one message in full by id (the id a memory or snippet pointed at):

```json
{"name": "search_conversation_history_tool", "arguments": {"conversation_id": 3870, "message_id": 76005}}
```

## Gotchas

- **Searches everything,** including messages compacted out of the model's context window.
- **`limit` caps at 20.** Refine the query rather than paging.
